# Copilot instructions for FieldShift 360

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root: it is the one guide for every coding agent (commands, layout,
the real-vs-sample data rule, which docs to check before changing behaviour). In short:

- `npm test` and `npm run build` are the validation path; there is no linter.
- Calculations belong in `src/engine/` (pure, tested with Node's runner), not in pages.
- Data in `src/data/` is generated by `scripts/` (index in `scripts/README.md`): change the script, do not hand-edit.
- Every user-facing string is bilingual through `T(bn, en)`; Bangla first.
